title: Sample project: a bowling day out
summary: An example of a day at the bowling lanes for a group of children: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.
story:
## Summary

A bowling day for a group of children: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.

## The need

A day out for a whole group of children takes transport, extra helpers and a budget, so it does not happen often. These are exactly the days a child remembers.

## The plan

A full day at the bowling lanes, where every child gets a turn and every roll gets a cheer, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

## What it leaves behind

A happy memory for every child. After the day the story and the pictures are shared here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.
